[P2] Preserve the callback promise's timing when exposing next

`guardedFn` omits `sourcePromise`, so the callback reaches `next()` through observation, `.catch()`, and this additional `.then()`. For callback `() => Promise.resolve("body")` and wrapper `(_, next) => Promise.race([next(), Promise.resolve().then(() => "deadline")])`, the base returns `"body"`, while this version returns `"deadline"`. The extra reactions change a successful callback into a deadline result. Keep private recovery observation separate from the exposed callback promise while preserving the base reaction depth, and add this ready-promise race regression.
